#C000246204Run as fast as you can#CDEF!

The fun hunt ends here.

…#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's heels click against the ground.

You're my possession.
My little doll.
This is the beginning of hell for #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

Guh…!
Not yet, not yet…!
#C236196003Archer#CDEF reanimates his failing body.
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's spike pierces my body.

Damn you…
Damn you, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF―――!
Guh… bgh…!
Now you belong to me, #C236196003Archer#CDEF.
…I hear heavy heels click against the ground…
…I'm sorry, #C236196003Archer#CDEF…
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF……!

Then we'll just prepare for the worst
and stall her as long as possible!

But first, ahem…
Hey! You, pervert over there!

I enjoyed this hunt.
It made me realize what I truly want to do.
Huh―――kya! What―――!?

!?
No, my rule was reversed instantly―――
Why are you aiding them, #C236196003BB#CDEF!?

I didn't side with #[him][her]#.
What I did was hinder YOU, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

…she voided the #C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF system in an instant?

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF! Just how many Servants

Wh―level 999…!?

This goes beyond cheating…!

Circuit connected!
Are you okay, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!?
#C236196003Sakura#CDEF…!?

Sorry, no can do!
Just run, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF!

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.

Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.

Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away

When it's time to rest, rest.

What!? Our entry point!

Wahh! I got spooked…!
This icy presence―it's her, isn't it!

This chill―so the #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF is here. Looks like
I have to pluck your chestnuts out of the fire
again, huh, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF?

Welcome to this place deeper within me.
This is what they mean by "like a moth
to a flame."

Communications with the Student Council Room have been cut off.
The stairs back to the old school building are blocked off.
Before us stands #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF, still invincible.
It doesn't get any worse than this…!

But I'm surprised you came here without a plan
or anything. Was me declaring that we would
"settle things now" uncalled for?

I heard that only small insects draw themselves
into fire, but lately humans have
also been eager to die.

Fine then, I'll crush you like an insect.
I'll take that pesky Servant out of the picture.
Then I'll assimilate you, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

Fine then, I'll crush you like an insect.
I'll take that pesky Master out of the picture.
Then I'll assimilate you, #C236196003Archer#CDEF.

Don't make me laugh. Assimilation is love?
A world with only you and yourself―――
A world without choice knows no freedom.

You speak of joy and pleasure, but basically,
all you want is a doll who keeps quiet!

Not going to happen.
As #[his][her]# guardian, I won't allow you two to
get chummy.

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
Assimilating another person can't be
called "love."

You rob your lover of free will; they should be
happy to merely exist―――That's an animal's
life, not the life of an intelligent human.

I told you before.
I'm not interested in humoring your obsession.

It's impossible based on the premise, anyway.
Let me remind you that my #ROFS0002#RUBS  lady#RUBEMaster#REND here is strong.

#C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF - #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
Your love isn't human; it disregards your
target's individuality and is warped.

You shamelessly talk of an affair in front of
#[his][her]# true wife!? No more delay, I'm purging
that festered head of yours!

The idea of assimilation is nasty, anyway.
It may sound cool, but it's basically all
about making someone yours, right?

The results were the same, but even that titty
monster's method had more charm to it! Women who
treat their lovers as #RUBS  things#RUBEvessels#REND are vile.

Darling belongs to me, anyhow!
Even #[his][her]# soul is on reserve, it's got my spit
all over it! So FORGET it!

…so, how does that make you any different
from me?

We're different in every way.
Your love is an assimilation of fate.
My love is a sharing of fate.

I share in the joy and suffering Darling
undergoes. Coming to accept the very life of
one's love… such is a wife's duty.

…#C236196003Caster#CDEF…
So that's how deeply she thinks of me…
Ah, oh, damn. I got carried away for a second there.

Right now isn't the time for that.
Later won't even be the time for that.

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF. What you say is true. If it were
anyone else, I would refute them, but I
won't condemn you as being evil.

In the first place, what even is love?
Is it absolute, or is it relative? Does it
persist indefinitely, or does it one day end?

Many women defer in answering, but you've had
answers from the very start―regardless if
those answers prove to be immoral.

You embody a maiden who forbids all dishonesty,
abhors all disagreement. However―――for that
very reason, you and #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF don't mix.

This #[man][woman]# is a wanderer who has no desire for
absolutes; a model "human" constantly changing.
No human will ever care for your fixated ways.

A person's world knows no eternity.
The moment you desired such is when your
love became destined for ruin―――!

To assimilate someone into yourself
basically means to turn them into your personal belonging.

Ridiculous. This is truly ridiculous.
You say that I'm not treating #C236196003#NICK#CDEF
as a human being?

Ridiculous. This is truly ridiculous, #C236196003Archer#CDEF.
I'm obsessive? You say I'm disregarding 
your individuality?
What did you say?
She's on the attack now!?

……hrm.
Now that she mentions it, she has been
saying so.

I have no need for anything human-like.
"Feelings" and whatnot make me sick, anyway.
Dolls are easier to love, don't you agree?

She never had any intention of having a
relationship based on mutual love―――!

It's a relief to know you understand me.
Now I have nothing left to be concerned about.
I can take you in.

Here she comes…!
It's over if she catches us―we still have
no way of beating #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Let's flee, #RUBS  Master#RUBEPraetor#REND!
We'll head to the end of the Labyrinth!

Run, Master!
Let's head to the Labyrinth's goal
like we planned!

D-damn this obsessive doll-freak…!
A bleak future awaits us if we get caught by
someone like that! Let's run away, Darling!

As much as it vexes me, let's run #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF!
This is where we retreat!

Hee hee. Just how long can you run, I wonder.
Let's get this fun hunt started!

We enter a wide-open space.
I still can't see the end of the Labyrinth.

The path forks.
I hesitate a bit and end up stopping in my tracks,
unsure of which one is right to take.

If we run into a dead end,
we'll be completely out of options―――!

You're only as fast as a human can be.
No matter where you flee with those legs of
yours, the outcome remains the same.

We may have to ready ourselves for the worst
now… Even if we can't win, we'll fight not to
lose. However… I want to ask something first.

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
Didn't you say that you hate humans, lout?

Yet my Praetor is a human.
You can still love #[him][her]#, regardless?

…guess all we can do now is buy enough time
for the comms to come back up… which is as
reckless as it gets.

But first, I'm going to ask you something. You
said you hated humans, but #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF is human.
You're still going to say you love #[him][her]#?

But first, I want to ask you something. You said
you hated humans, but I was human once.
I don't really think I'm eligible for you.

Even if we continue to the end, not being able
to contact #C236196003Rin#CDEF and the others puts us in a
hard place…

I'm fine with you hating humans, but aren't
you contradicting yourself? Darling is human.
Can you actually love #[him][her]#?

Regardless of which path is correct, it appears
we must stall for time. Until communications are
reestablished, we can't destroy the Shield.

So, how about a question first? #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF. You
loathe humans, yet this one here is human. Will
you still love #[him][her]#, despite that?

I do love #[him][her]#. After all, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF being
human isn't the reason why I like #[him][her]#. Being
human is actually #[his][her]# one and only flaw.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. I'll slice away all of your human
parts for you. So become a 2-D character,
become my #RUBS     thing #RUBEpossession#REND already!

…you're right. It's strange. I do hate humans.
That will never change.
Still…

It seems that I like you even with that
unpleasant part of you, #C236196003Archer#CDEF. I thought only
#C236196003BB#CDEF possessed contradictions like this.

#C236196003#NICK#CDEF. Sorry, but begone.
I won't even bother assimilating you.
That man is MY #RUBS thing#RUBElover#REND!

Her footwork reminds me of a ballerina.
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF dashes.
She leaps forward seeking to end my life―this time for sure.
However, right before that happens―

That's far enough.
You've been egomaniacal, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

Wait, this is a virtual image of #C236196003BB#CDEF.
Just like before, she opened up a circuit into this Labyrinth.

I won't tolerate alterations to the system.
Only I am allowed to be #RUBS  invincible#RUBElegendary#REND.
One god is plenty enough.

I bestowed on you only the power that
you needed. Use only your own strength to fight.

Devote yourself to your original duty,
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF. Guarding my back is the
reason for your existence.

H-her head is in the clouds…! This is my
problem with the original! She has absolutely
no clue what her priorities should be!

This is our chance, #RUBS  Master#RUBEPraetor#REND!
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's invincibility is no more!
Let's give her no time to breathe!

…being denied by your own parent?
Now that's karma. Not that I have any
sympathy for you, though.

Now, then―――
Show us just how tough you are now that
you've lost your invincibility, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Hrm. Sabotaging one's own comrade? Her ungodly
idiocy is unveiled at last. I would laugh at
them for being typical yanderes, but…

Hrmmm. It's a bit of a worrisome omen, but
that's something to deal with later.
Now get ready: here we come, skimpy!

So, one problem gone without us lifting a
finger. You aren't merely unlucky; your parental
luck is unfortunate as well, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

Perhaps you've paid your dues, but for now
let's take a look: how about we gauge your
true strength now without your invincibility?

―――Hmph.
#C236196003BB#CDEF gets a little capricious in your favor,
and you're off to the races.

Fine, I'll give you a dose of reality.
Have yourself a taste of just how deep my love
is, how thorough my nectar is!

*kgh*! What power…!
Her invincibility may have lifted,
but we gained no edge!

We were too optimistic, huh―――!
We can damage her now, but that's
pretty much it!

―――This was a bad idea.
Even though her invincibility is gone,
our base skills are too far apart.

#C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF―――
How many levels have you stolen using that 
shameless #RUBS     drain   #RUBEabsorbtion#REND ability?

Hmph. I knew we were still the ones facing
a dilemma. #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF with the drain skill:
how many levels have you siphoned, scum?

Pfft―――ahahahahaha!
THAT'S your question? For me?

Do you remember the design, the brand,
the amount of calories of every dessert
you've ever eaten in your life?

Level-draining to me is akin to breathing.
If you still insist on knowing, I'll at least
give you a description of my power.

Hear this and despair: I'm level 999.
I constantly maintain my level by giving
this frame as much as it can hold!

Have you realized this? If I weren't constrained
by this upper limit on my level, I would be
an AI who surpasses even #C236196003BB#CDEF.

After #C236196003BB#CDEF breaks down, I'll continue
her remaining work. At that point, the first
thing I'll do is remove the limit on my level.

Once I do that―――
So long as there are humans,
I can grow infinitely.

If I end up raising my level #ROFS0004#RUBS  1,000,000,000,000#RUBEto a trillion,#REND
I should be able to take in the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF
without being deleted.

This is my, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's true#ROFS0001#RUBS calamity#RUBE power#REND.
Get it? Don't get your hopes up just because
my invincibility is gone.
…this is unbelievable.

Does #C236196003BB#CDEF know about this?
It's possible that the #C000246204Ego#CDEF she generated could end
up destroying not only the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF, but her as well.

So, how about we continue this pleasure theater?
There's nowhere to run. First an arm, then a
leg… I'll melt and drink one part at a time!

Our comms are back… Then does that mean
the stairs are back, too!?
My body reacts to #C236196003Rin#CDEF's instructions before my mind does.
I take #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's hand and dash towards that path.

For the time being, all we can do is
get away from #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF…!
Return to the previous floor?
Return to previous floor.
Return to the old school.

Ahh, now this is the best.
If only all the other humans acted like you do!

How weak you are. Just a glimpse of me
causes the fear to crawl up your spine.

Don't worry, I'll clean up your remains after.
Everything will fit nicely in the trashcan.

When I'm done with you,
you'll look just like shredded paper!
How long do you really think you can run for?

"Dance, dance Albrecht,
as punishment for playing with my feelings～"
Good good, don't give up too easily!!

How captivating… Let me carve right into
that back of yours already!
You're making this a lot of fun, human!
Defeating #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF now is impossible.

This is #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's Labyrinth.
Our chances of getting away were extremely low.
All we can do at this point is fight our hardest…!
Fine by me. I'll grant you one final act!

My heels are Giselle's demonic blades.
They curse everything to exhaustion.

Beloved one―――
Sink now into a night from which you'll
never wake!

The nectar which spews forth dissolves #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's
body from the inside.
The only parts left―experience and skills―are
offered to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

That's #C000246204All Drain#CDEF… the illegal skill permitted
only to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF, the #C000246204Ego#CDEF of pleasure―――

Hee hee. Delicious. What wonderful Spiritrons
you were made of, Servant. Curse your own
inexperience as you exist within me.

Now―――time for the main dish, our long-
awaited first night together, my beloved. My
heart is beating. I could die happy right now.

Are you ready? Any requests? Tell me―――
how painful, how lightly do you want to be
melted down?

…following #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's destruction,
  my vitality and magical energy drain from my entire body.
  I can't even lift my head up anymore.
  At this rate, I'm―――

Haaa―――ahhh―――
I can't get enough of this. So warm. This is
something I always, always wanted to do――

Now I'm going to protect you.
I won't let #C236196003BB#CDEF get in our way.

All I have is you. All you have is me.
I'll melt the entire world to death and offer
it to you, my beloved.

When you wake up, when you see your brand
new body in a brand new world, please let out
a consummate cry for me―――

…my consciousness is fading.
  My limbs are dissolving.
  #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF is absorbing just about every part of me.

I, reduced to a mere object and no longer
capable of even dying, will continue hearing
whispers of a one-sided love―――

…but it's too late.
We've lost all hope of victory,
and my magical energy is depleted.

I have no more magical energy to send to #C236196003Archer#CDEF.
At this rate, I'm―――

Yes, it's over for you.
Still, I'll be gentle as I put you to sleep.
A token of my thanks, for bringing him to me.

The nectar which spews forth dissolves me from the inside.
The only parts left―my experience and skills―
are offered to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

This is #C000246204All Drain#CDEF… the illegal skill
permitted only to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF, the #C000246204Ego#CDEF of pleasure―――

Now―――time for the main dish, our long-
awaited first night together, my beloved. My
heart is beating. I could die happy right now.

Are you ready? Any requests? Tell me―――
how painful, how lightly do you want to be
melted down?

Haaa―――ahhh―――
I can't get enough of this. So warm.
So this is what love feels like―――

All I have is you. All you have is me.
I'll melt the entire world to death and offer
it to you, my beloved.

…there's nothing I can do for you now…
  Unlike #C236196003Leo#CDEF, I can't even release you―――
